organization_and_why.name: Pearls Of Wellness Alternative Health Care Ministry
organization_and_why.why: domestic cold storage, takes up to 1 pallet, collects within 3h
organization_and_why.profile_excerpt: Storefront pantry open two afternoons a week, serving about 92 households. One household refrigerator. No freezer, no dock, no pallet handling. No loading area at all - deliveries block the street while we unload.

whose_neighborhood.populations_served: Residents of the surrounding school district
whose_neighborhood.tract: Nearest census tract: 35% of residents below the poverty line, 40% of households without a vehicle, 45% on food or cash assistance (ACS; recipient location is ZIP-level, so this is the area, not the exact block).

outreach_message:
Hello Pearls Of Wellness Alternative Health Care Ministry team,

A grocer in Chicago has ten crates of spinach. It is still good but has to move soon. From what we have on file you have the storage for it. The food needs to leave by about 6 hours from now, which leaves you roughly 3 hours of slack to collect. We can arrange a driver, since it has to stay cold on the way.

Can you take it? If you can, tell us the time you can collect and a phone number for pickup. If not, a quick no helps us move to the next place.

Thank you,
[Coordinator name]
